# Waiback

> Waiback is a wayback machine for large language models by Ted Kwartler. Every model is asked the same fixed set of questions and its answers are preserved with a date, so you can see how models answer and how that changes as they are added and updated.

Models: 6 | Questions: 12 | Updated: 2026-10-03

## Models (newest first)
- [OpenAI: GPT-6.1 Sol Pro](https://waiback.org/models/openai_gpt-6.1-sol-pro.html): released 2026-09-29, publisher OpenAI.
- [Anthropic: Claude Sonnet 5.5](https://waiback.org/models/anthropic_claude-sonnet-5.5.html): released 2026-09-28, publisher Anthropic.
- [Qwen: Qwen3.8 Max Prime](https://waiback.org/models/qwen_qwen3.8-max-prime.html): released 2026-09-23, publisher Qwen.
- [SpaceXAI: Grok 4.7](https://waiback.org/models/x-ai_grok-4.7.html): released 2026-09-21, publisher SpaceXAI.
- [DeepSeek: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash](https://waiback.org/models/deepseek_deepseek-v4.1-flash.html): released 2026-09-10, publisher DeepSeek.
- [Google: Gemini 3.8 Flash](https://waiback.org/models/google_gemini-3.8-flash.html): released 2026-09-02, publisher Google.
